description: CVE report templates for discovered vulnerabilities

templates.title: Command Injection Vulnerability in MCP Server
templates.description: The MCP server fails to sanitize user input before passing it to system commands, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary commands.
templates.remediation: Use parameterized commands, validate input against allowlist, avoid system() calls

templates.title: SQL Injection Vulnerability in MCP Server
templates.description: The MCP server improperly handles user input in database queries, allowing SQL injection attacks.
templates.remediation: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements

templates.title: Server-Side Template Injection in MCP Server
templates.description: The MCP server evaluates user input as template code without proper sanitization.
templates.remediation: Disable template engine access to dangerous classes, sanitize user input

templates.title: Path Traversal Vulnerability in MCP Server
templates.description: The MCP server fails to validate file paths, allowing attackers to read arbitrary files.
templates.remediation: Normalize paths, restrict to whitelisted directories, use chroot

templates.title: Server-Side Request Forgery in MCP Server
templates.description: The MCP server allows attackers to make arbitrary HTTP requests.
templates.remediation: Implement whitelist of allowed URLs, disable schema other than HTTP/HTTPS

templates.title: XML External Entity Injection in MCP Server
templates.description: The MCP server processes XML input with external entity resolution enabled.
templates.remediation: Disable DTD processing, use secure XML parsers

templates.title: NoSQL Injection in MCP Server
templates.description: The MCP server fails to sanitize JSON input, allowing NoSQL injection attacks.
templates.remediation: Validate and sanitize all JSON input, use parameterized queries

templates.title: LDAP Injection in MCP Server
templates.description: The MCP server fails to escape LDAP search filters.
templates.remediation: Escape LDAP special characters, use parameterized LDAP queries
